description: Observations on a proposed development within the adjoining borough of Wandsworth with respect to: "Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for variations to Conditions 3 (Reserved Matters), 5 (Design Codes), 6 (Design Codes Landscaping Details), 7 (Parameter Plans), 8 (Land Uses), 11 (Maximum Floorspace Area in outline element for each Phase or Development Zone), 14 (Residential Mix), 18 (Phasing Plan), 20 (Car Parking), 35 (Sustainability and Energy) and 61 (Approved Drawings) of outline planning permission dated 28th February 2022 (ref. 2021/0414) for: ''the restoration, extension, alterations and conversion of the Power Station building to provide retail, residential flats, business, cultural, hotel and conference facilities, event space and incidental accommodation; the demolition of other buildings and development of the land surrounding the Power Station and adjacent/nearby sites to provide retail, restaurants bars and cafes, offices, hotel, residential, community and cultural space, assembly and leisure space, serviced apartments, an energy centre and basement plant; parking for cars, coaches, motorcycles and bicycles; new access and internal road system and servicing; 'off-site' highway works; works to the jetty and riverwall to facilitate river transport and fuel delivery; provision of open space and landscaping.'' (The application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement).", at: Battersea Power Station development site SW8 5BN, London Borough of Wandsworth application ref. 2026/3243.
